test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Peculiar
solution:
The correct answer is** "Unusual".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Let's see the meaning of the synonym:

__
 
• **Peculiar -** unusual and strange, sometimes in an unpleasant way:

 
 
• **​*Eg.*** She has the most *peculiar *ideas.
 
 
 
• **​Unusual - **different from others of the same type in a way that is surprising, interesting, or attractive
 
 
• ***Eg.*** ​"Do you like the new couch?" "Yes, it's very *unusual*." ​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Here let's learn the meaning of the other words:

 
• **Customary - **usual

 
 
• ***Eg. ***She's not her *customary *cheerful self today.
 
 
 
• **Perplexed -** confused, because something is difficult to understand or solve
 
 
• ***Eg. ***The students looked *perplexed*, so the teacher tried to explain once again.
 
 
 
• **Proven - **to show a particular result after a period of time
 
 
• ***Eg.*** The operation *proved* a complete success.
